question: Which of the following is the domestic first-class cricket championship in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ranji Trophy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ranji Trophy** is the premier first-class cricket championship played in India.
 
• It was named after the famous Indian cricketer **Ranjitsinhji**, who played for England and Sussex.
 
• The championship was first played in the **1934-35 season**.
 
• Teams representing regional and state cricket associations compete in this tournament.
 
• The **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)** organizes the Ranji Trophy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Santosh Trophy** is associated with football in India.
 
• The **Thomas Cup** is related to badminton and is an international team event.
 
• The **Durand Cup** is one of the oldest football tournaments in India.
